title: Flowers beside the coast
author: Carlquist, Sherwin John, 1930-2021
source_description: Photograph of Hoya vine stems from Lae, Papua New Guinea. A hand holds up several woody vine stems with dark green oval leaves, and larger light green cordate leaves. Several clusters of umbel inflorescences, with minute white star-shaped florets, are attached to a vertical stem. In the foreground is a coastline with white waves, and in the background is a large body of water and a strip of land on the horizon.1 photograph : positive, col. ; 35 mm.
